# freshdesk_email_mailbox (Data Source)

Look up a single support mailbox by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_email_mailbox" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the email mailbox to look up.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the mailbox is accepting mail.
- `created_at` (String) When the mailbox was created (RFC 3339).
- `csat_settings` (String) Satisfaction survey settings, as JSON.
- `default_reply_email` (Boolean) Whether replies are sent from this address.
- `forward_email` (String) Address to forward mail to, if Freshdesk-hosted.
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the group tickets are assigned to.
- `mailbox_type` (String) Whether the mailbox is Freshdesk-hosted or custom.
- `name` (String) Name of the mailbox.
- `product_id` (Number) ID of the product the mailbox belongs to.
- `support_email` (String) Address customers write to.
- `updated_at` (String) When the mailbox was last changed (RFC 3339).
